# ☣️ CorruptedSMP — Ultimate Progression & Mechanics

**CorruptedSMP** adds a complete, immersive corruption system to Minecraft, packing your server with powerful abilities, custom crafting recipes, mystical rituals, passive effects, and server-wide progression! 

Players can embark on a dark journey to unlock, craft, and activate unique corruptions through high-stakes ritual processes, unleashing game-changing powers to dominate in both PvP combat and survival. Whether you want to master the elements, manipulate your health, or bring absolute chaos to the battlefield, this plugin provides everything you need to run an unforgettable SMP experience.

### ✨ Key Features
Explore a completely customized experience packed with unique progression and mechanics:

* **9 Unique Corruptions** — Choose your path with distinct playstyles and traits.
* **Custom Abilities & Passive Effects** — Unlock game-changing active and passive powers.
* **Custom Crafting Recipes** — Craft custom items and corruption cores.
* **Server-Wide Crafting Limits** — Perfectly balance your economy and server progression.
* **Recipe Editor GUI** — Easily customize item requirements directly in-game.
* **Action Bar Cooldowns** — Track your ability timers seamlessly on your main screen.
* **Highly Configurable** — Tweak options, values, and mechanics to fit your server style.
* **Modern Support** — Fully optimized for Minecraft `1.21.1+`.

---

### ☣️ Included Corruptions
Each corruption grants entirely unique attributes, visual elements, and powers:

* **Health Corruption** ❤️ 
* **Ocean Corruption** 🌊 
* **Invincibility Corruption** 🛡️
* **Velocity Corruption** ⚡ 
* **Fire Corruption** 🔥 
* **Breeze Corruption** ☁️ 
* **Ender Corruption** 🔮 
* **Darkness Corruption** 🌑 
* **Clown Corruption** 🎪

---

### 🎨 Required Texture Pack
To see the custom corruption items, cores, and visuals correctly, make sure to download our official resource pack! 

* **Download Link:** Join our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/kkwnp8Mp5P) and head over to the resource pack channel to grab the latest version.

---

### 🔮 Ritual System
Players craft corruption cores and activate them through a unique ritual process. After completing the ritual, the corruption is permanently obtained and its powerful abilities become available.

### ⚖️ Crafting Limits
Control the rarity of corruptions on your server with server-wide crafting limits. Easily set custom limits per corruption, or allow unlimited crafting for a chaotic experience.

---

### 💻 Commands

#### 👤 Player Commands
* `/ability` — Activate the main Corruption ability (Can also be activated without commands by holding **Left Shift + Right Click**).
* `/withdraw` — Withdraw your current corruption or core.
* `/recipes` — View custom crafting recipes.
* `/craftinfo` — Check the remaining global server crafting limits.

#### 👑 Admin Commands
* `/corrupt give <player> <corruption>` — Give a specific corruption to a player.
* `/corrupt reset <player>` — Reset and clear a player's corruption.
* `/corrupt info <player>` — View detailed corruption stats for a player.
* `/corrupt list` — List all available corruptions in the plugin.
* `/corrupt clearcooldown <player>` — Reset a player's ability cooldowns.
* `/corrupt craftlimit <corruption> <amount>` — Adjust server-wide crafting limits on the fly.
* `/corrupt reload` — Reload all configuration files and data.
* `/recipeeditor` — Open the in-game GUI to customize crafting recipes.

---

### ⚙️ Requirements
To ensure the plugin runs smoothly, make sure your server environment meets the following specifications:

* **Minecraft Version:** `1.21.1+`
* **Java Version:** `Java 21+`
* **Server Software:** `Paper` (Highly Recommended) or `Spigot`
